blind.B1: The series is a bed-rest disuse/re-ambulation trial with placebo vs metformin (older adults, vastus lateralis), not an exercise study (ABS, S2.5, S3.4). No exercise arm; the physical-activity axis is disuse then reloading. All 113 RNA-seq samples carry it only in that sense (PRE, DAY1, POST, REC, plus clamp biopsies).
blind.B2: Within-arm POST vs PRE and REC vs PRE in placebo and in metformin (S3.4.p1, Fig 5a-d). Paper DEG counts: 441 / 3550 placebo, 377 / 1386 metformin. N = 9-10/group (Fig 5 legend).
blind.B3: Yes. Each participant is biopsied at PRE, DAY1, POST, REC (S2.4.p1). GEO has no participant ID; the `subject` column in packet A is not a usable pairing key in the raw metadata (0/113 linked), and title-without-run links only 24 samples. A key must be derived from sample-number blocks (each starting at a PREbc biopsy), with age/sex/treatment constant inside a block.
blind.B4: The paper does not state the DESeq2 design formula (S2.7.p1: 'DESeq2 version 1.30.00 and the hciR package'); per-arm volcano plots suggest per-arm fits.
blind.B5: S2.7.p1: 'Differentially expressed genes were identified using a 5% false discovery rate with DESeq2 version 1.30.00 and the hciR package.' No fold-change cutoff stated. Fig 5 legend: 'Log10 Adjusted p-value of 1.3 (p < 0.05) was used to determine significance for volcano plots.' Counts: 441, 377 (bed rest), 3550, 1386 (recovery) (S3.4.p1). Pathways: fgsea at 10% FDR.

checks.evidence: Ran as a disuse/re-ambulation study; caveat in study record says 'not exercise training' (S2.5, S3.4).

Fasted PRE/POST/REC only; clamp (ac) and DAY1 excluded with reasons (S2.4, S3.4). Placebo 9 participants vs Table 1 10 and metformin 9 vs 10 after sex-label exclusions, both recorded as discrepancies.
Contrasts POST vs PRE and REC vs PRE with PRE as control, as in the paper (S3.4.p1).

B3: repeated biopsies; model ~ subject + time with subject derived from PREbc-anchored blocks, derivation labelled as an assumption in method deviations and study caveats; unpaired sensitivity run alongside.
Paper formula not stated (S2.7.p1); per-arm fits match per-arm volcano plots; both paired and unpaired fits reported.
Sequencing run and sex nested within subject and absorbed; two runs and sex mislabels recorded; no non-bed-rest control noted as caveat.
Integer counts, DESeq2 as in the paper (pydeseq2 vs R 1.30/hciR deviation recorded).

Transcribed correctly: padj<0.05, no FC (S2.7.p1). Packet B table shows padj<0.05 & |log2FC|>0.585 gives 3252 (paper 3550) and 1422 (paper 1386) for REC, closer than the applied 5764/2668; HANDBACK discusses the unpaired fit but I did not see it record the FC-rule fit.
checks.fix: Add one line to HANDBACK/discrepancies that the paper's REC counts also fit padj<0.05 with |log2FC|>0.585 although the stated rule has no FC cutoff.

checks.evidence: Same four contrasts compared at the same stated rule; HANDBACK reports the large gap (e.g. 5764 vs 3550) and claims only qualitative agreement.

human_items: Open policy: whether a bed-rest disuse/re-ambulation series counts as a physical-activity (exercise) study.
Open policy: which threshold to report when paper REC counts fit padj<0.05 & |log2FC|>0.585 rather than the stated rule.
summary: 该研究是卧床(失用)与恢复期试验,并非运动训练,分析已如实标注。受试者ID由样本序号块推导,按受试者分块的 ~ subject + time 模型合理,并附无配对的敏感性分析。阈值转录正确;仅建议补记论文数字也符合 |log2FC|>0.585 规则。
